messages:
Eli (CEO): @here Quick heads-up — company all-hands tomorrow 11am PT in the main conference room + Zoom. Please read agenda below and drop any Qs in this thread or the form. Recording will be posted afterward. :sparkles:

Maya (Head of Product): Agenda highlights: 1) Q1 roadmap check-in, 2) Redwood Dedicated launch status, 3) reliability & incidents summary, 4) open Q&A. If you have product-related questions, tag me or add them to the form: https://forms.gle/redwood-allhands-q

Oliver (Eng Manager): For the Dedicated launch update I can bring perf numbers and the canary rollout plan. Pls add any specific metrics you want to see (p99 latency, tokens/sec, cost/unit).

Sophie (People Ops): Reminder: hybrid lunch provided afterward for in-office folks. If remote and want lunch stipend, DM me by EOD. Also collecting questions for the AMA portion — anonymous option in the form. :salad:

Eli (CEO): Takeaways we want staff to leave with: clarity on Dedicated timing, what reliability steps we're taking after the recent incident, and a clear ramp plan for hiring FY25. Keep Qs concise — we'll triage in the form and reserve 15 minutes for live Q&A.

Oliver (Eng Manager): Putting the incident postmortem link here for context: https://redwood.company/incident/2026-03-cpu-throttle — will summarize the three action items at the all-hands.

Maya (Head of Product): Quick ask for folks owning customer stories — if you have a short launch highlight (1-2 slides) ping me so we can slot it.

Sophie (People Ops): Can we do a 5-minute pulse at the end for anonymity? thumbs up if ok. :+1:

Eli (CEO): Yup, we'll run the pulse. Also note: we'll announce updated parental leave policy during the all-hands (short change to return-to-work flexibility). HR will send details afterward.

Oliver (Eng Manager): Will demo: rolling fallback routing and autoscale thresholds. Will also call out config changes that impacted the incident.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Calendar invite sent to everyone. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (password in invite). Recording will be attached to the event after the meeting.

Maya (Head of Product): If it's helpful, drop one or two quick Qs here so we can cluster them ahead of time. e.g., 'When will Dedicated GA?' 'How are we measuring cost improvements?'

Eli (CEO): Thanks all — please add any questions by 10am tomorrow so we can prep answers. See you then. :rocket:
